name: System Usability Scale
description: The ten-item System Usability Scale with its standard five-point agreement response scale and scoring rule.
introPrompt: Think about the system that you have just used and indicate how strongly you agree or disagree with each statement.
officialContentNotice: The ten SUS statements, five response values and alternating scoring rule remain unchanged.

source.label: Brooke, J. (1996), SUS: A quick and dirty usability scale

items.name: Item 1
items.prompt: I think that I would like to use this system frequently.

items.name: Item 2
items.prompt: I found the system unnecessarily complex.

items.name: Item 3
items.prompt: I thought the system was easy to use.

items.name: Item 4
items.prompt: I think that I would need the support of a technical person to be able to use this system.

items.name: Item 5
items.prompt: I found the various functions in this system were well integrated.

items.name: Item 6
items.prompt: I thought there was too much inconsistency in this system.

items.name: Item 7
items.prompt: I would imagine that most people would learn to use this system very quickly.

items.name: Item 8
items.prompt: I found the system very cumbersome to use.

items.name: Item 9
items.prompt: I felt very confident using the system.

items.name: Item 10
items.prompt: I needed to learn a lot of things before I could get going with this system.
